implementation.engine: the source commit's own unchanged backtest.run (native admission, registered management), one sleeve, max_pos 1 from the start
implementation.signals: the unchanged registered signal function, computed per coin on that coin's real history only (a BTC + coin book); no candle is invented
implementation.one_account_over_late_listings: the account book spans BTC's full timeline; a coin has no candles and no signals before its own data starts; its indicator columns and signals are the ones computed on its real history
implementation.sizing: fixed $8 risk and $3,333.33 notional cap on every entry: the engine sizes from equity, so equity is set to $10,000,000 with risk 0.0000008 and max_lev 0.000333333 (P&L drift moves these by under 0.02%). $4,000 is the research-capital denominator for reporting only
implementation.R: R_budget = net closed P&L in USD / 8 (primary). R_actual = the engine's own R (reported, never used for a gate)
implementation.costs: engine base 5 bp fee + 2 bp slippage per side (7 bp); 15 / 23 bp add 8 / 16 bp on each trade's executed notional from the fill log; funding proxy 1 bp / 8 h on open notional, both sides, not native funding
implementation.eligibility: entries only at decisions where: t >= 2022-08-26 06:00 UTC; the coin's own bar number >= warmup (220); D01 point-in-time liquidity at the decision's last 1h bar (median daily quote volume of the prior 30 complete UTC days >= $10m and >= 720 consecutive hourly bars). Exits are never masked
implementation.bars: 4h = complete UTC groups of four 1h bars; management on the alpha's own bars (4h for ema_st, 1h for c101)
implementation.paths: primary pessimistic='path'; diagnostic pessimistic='worst' (stop-first), reported, not a gate
implementation.orders: 40 symbol orders: order 0 alphabetical, order k = numpy.default_rng(20261112 + k).permutation of the alphabetical list, k = 1..39
implementation.terminal: a position still open at the end of data is not a completed trade and is not counted
implementation.exchange_filters: data/exchange_rules_testnet.json of the source commit (current snapshot)
implementation.daily_halt: engine default 0.08 of equity; cannot bind at this size; rule v1 defines no halt

medians_over_40_orders_at_15bp: ex-best-coin mean > 0 (best coin = largest summed net P&L at 15 bp in that order; its closed trades removed, no rerun)
gates.result_label: TRANSFER_SCREEN_PASS at most; never PAPER, activation or mainnet approval
